Location

North-east of Edron, near the mountain pass to the north

Notes

He is a hero on a quest for King Tibianus. He has information about the Excalibug, the Ruthless Seven and the Pits of Inferno. His name is possibly a reference to the Avatar, the main character of the Ultima Series.

Part of What a foolish Quest, mission 10.
Part of the Demon Outfits Quest.
